about.preflight: Checks the cluster is reachable, the manifests lint clean, required checks pass on the target and every workload is settled.
about.merge_prs: Merges each picked pull request once its checks pass, updating stale branches first.
about.changelog: Opens and merges a pull request that adds this version’s changelog file to main.
about.tag: Creates the version tag on the changelog commit. Anything not on main is refused.
about.release: Publishes the GitHub release for the tag, with the changelog highlights as notes.
about.build: Waits for the image workflow on GitHub to finish and follows each image’s build jobs.
about.digests: Looks up every built image and checks it has both architectures, the right commit and provenance.
about.pin_pr: Opens and merges a pull request that pins main’s manifests to the new image digests.
about.acl: Applies the NATS config and waits until every NATS server has reloaded it and gone quiet.
about.rollout: Applies shared config, then rolls one service at a time and waits for its pods before the next.
about.verify: Checks every pod runs its pinned image and the status pages answer. A miss offers a rollback.

state.pending: Starts once the stages before it finish.
state.waiting: Paused until something outside the run is ready.
state.failed: Stopped here. Nothing after it ran.
